verdict.rationale: Databricks documents a broad programmatic surface: a workspace-level REST API reference covering supported operations, versioned REST APIs, the Databricks CLI for automation, the Python SDK, and Unity Catalog objects managed through REST APIs and CLI as well as Catalog Explorer. However, no evidence asserts UI/API parity across the platform, and a hands-on community report says there is 'no good way to get usage info programmatically', a concrete gap. Missing for 10: an explicit documented UI-to-API parity guarantee, programmatic usage/billing info access, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent corroboration of complete coverage.
